environment: Local Node.js process querying the configured remote database with pg and a maximum of five pooled connections
safety: Read-only connections; only timings and query counts recorded
scope: Service calls only, excluding page authorization and browser navigation
limitations: The first invocation of each service expands the pool with additional connections; initial connection costs are not isolated
Earlier measurements and these samples were not interleaved under identical network conditions
This is not a measurement of deployed end-to-end navigation
